title: Tiny humans in thermal imagery
blurb: Most of my M.Tech. A person seen from a drone in thermal infrared can be a blob of a few pixels. I designed lightweight detectors that still find them, cheaply enough to run on the drone itself.

title: Ships in messy seas
blurb: Collaborations on detecting ships in optical remote sensing images, where waves, haze and clouds make everything harder.

title: Forests from LiDAR
blurb: At ISRO, I turned airborne LiDAR point clouds of dense forest into individual tree crowns using a region-growing algorithm, then checked the results against ground truth.
